activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
Changing into work clothes and packing bag for the shift
Commuting to the health care facility
Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and completing clinical duties
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating, then washing up dishes
Watching TV news and reading the rolling blackout warning for the evening peak
Charging phone and computer while the grid is still up, and checking work messages
Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
Relaxing under the desk lamp, reading and winding down
